text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past purchases and listening as broad, continuing interest in related products or content.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a specific established interest, such as the same artist, recurring holiday theme, or existing device ecosystem.",
    "Practical accessories and complementary supplies appeal when they support a recognizable task involving items already used."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with more directly relevant choices despite lacking evidence of a current task, compatible equipment, or desired content.",
    "Past ownership is treated as continuing demand even when recent purchases already satisfy the need or recommended alternatives duplicate one another.",
    "Occasional or older interests receive weight that does not reflect the stronger, repeated interests shaping the current choice."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad product families, shared terminology, musical eras, and generic collection formats substitute for specific functional or content fit.",
    "Interest in one device, material, or musical style is extended to adjacent products and styles without sufficient supporting history."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Repeated and recent interactions identify specific tasks, artists, themes, and listening qualities more precisely than broad historical affinity.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, physical format, equipment requirements, and quantity determine whether a related product is usable.",
    "Existing ownership and overlapping alternatives affect whether an otherwise relevant item fills an unmet need now."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The strongest positions contain too many loosely related choices whose specific purpose or content does not match a supported current interest or unmet need.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users select for a concrete connection to recent or repeated behavior, compared with those described as merely related.",
    "The frequency of rejected recommendations requiring unsupported equipment, incompatible specifications, or needs already satisfied by recent purchases.",
    "The frequency of weak adjacent-interest recommendations ranking above direct task, artist, theme, or ecosystem matches.",
    "The proportion of recommendations users cannot assess because the available item information does not establish their content, tracked separately from explicit mismatch."
  ]
}
